prompt: What are the primary manufacturing components of a Single-use bioreactor? List each component on its own line.
components: Bioreactor vessel (typically made of plastic film or bag)
Mixing system (e.g., magnetic stirrer, rocking platform, or integrated impeller)
Sensor probes (e.g., pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature)
Ports and fittings (for sampling, addition of nutrients, and gas exchange)
Support frame or rocking platform (for stability and mixing)
Sterile filters (for gas and liquid sterilization)
